A NVRAM block descriptor contains all needed information about a single NVRAM block. Protection Enabled TRUE: Write protection shall be enabled FALSE: Write protection shall be disabled Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ Return - Type E_ OK: The block was enabled/ disabled as requested E_ NOT_ OK: An error occured. Description Service for setting/ resetting the write protection for a NV block. Available via Nv M.h
